## Fixed

- **Time left was far too long on Drime backups.** A backup that started
  slowly (Drime creating folders, or asking to slow down) and then sped up
  kept showing up to twice the time it really had left, for many minutes.
  The estimate now follows the speed the backup is going at now, and is
  within about 15% once it has sped up.

- **Windows Defender quarantining r2b.exe.** The taskbar app checked the
  backup schedule by starting Windows' `schtasks` tool twice a minute, all
  day, which Defender can mistake for malware. It now checks every ten
  minutes, and right away whenever you change the schedule in the panel.

## Heads up

- If Defender already quarantined r2b.exe 1.5.1 on your computer, open
  Windows Security → Protection history, choose **Allow** on the r2b.exe
  entry, then install this version.
